dog.description_text:
Oscar is a 3-year-old terrier mix who weighs around 20 lbs and has a lot of personality packed into a little body. He’s energetic, very smart, and a total lovebug at home. Wherever his person is, Oscar is usually right there too, happily settling down nearby so he can keep you company.

He’s house-trained, does great in his crate at night and when left for errands, and is a very social host when people come over. Oscar greets visitors at the door, asks for pets and attention, and wastes no time making himself part of the gathering. He’s also working on his leash skills, since all the new sounds, smells, and activity of the city can sometimes get the better of his excitement. He’ll do well with adopters who are happy to keep helping him channel that enthusiasm while enjoying all the affection he has to give.

Registered adopters interested in Oscar can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
